name: Synthetic research retrieval tutorial (not a quality benchmark)

chunks.title: Synthetic hybrid retrieval note
chunks.text: Hybrid retrieval combines lexical BM25 and vector rankings through reciprocal rank fusion. Retrieved passages are candidates for human evidence review.

chunks.title: Synthetic graph retrieval note
chunks.text: Graph retrieval traverses entity co-mention edges between passages. Entity connections retrieve related context but do not prove that a scientific claim is true.

chunks.title: Synthetic battery terminology note
chunks.text: Lithium ion batteries use electrochemical cells. This synthetic note supplies battery vocabulary for a retrieval demonstration, not experimental findings.

chunks.title: Synthetic image segmentation note
chunks.text: Convolution image segmentation labels pixels. This synthetic passage distinguishes image processing vocabulary from lexical retrieval and electrochemistry.

chunks.title: Synthetic BM25 note
chunks.text: BM25 sparse lexical retrieval scores repeated query terms against corpus document frequencies. It does not use learned semantic embeddings.

chunks.title: Synthetic evidence review note
chunks.text: A human reviewer checks original passages, limitations, and conflicting findings. A citation or lexical overlap score is not proof of factual correctness.
